types.name: Census, sample survey and errors
types.description: Compares census with sample surveys or asks about sampling, non-sampling, biased or non-response errors.

types.name: Sampling methods
types.description: Describes how units are picked and asks which sampling method it is, or which method is random or non-random.

types.name: Simple random sampling counts
types.description: Asks how many samples are possible or the chance of a unit being picked under simple random sampling with or without replacement.

types.name: Systematic sampling
types.description: Asks for the sampling interval k or which units are picked from a list with a random start.

types.name: Allocation in stratified sampling
types.description: Gives stratum sizes (and maybe SDs) and asks how many units to take from each stratum.

types.name: Standard error
types.description: Asks for the standard error of a mean or proportion, the effect of changing n, or the finite population correction.
